headline: ONF reveal Version 2 of official light stick
sub: Black-and-gold clock design nods to the original
caption:
ONF have unveiled the design of their new official light stick, Version 2.

Revealed Nov 24 on the group's official X, the new model keeps the clock motif of the original with sleek black and gold accents. Sales details have not been announced yet.

📌 Source: ONF official X
